sections.crash_profile: From {{window_start}} to {{window_end}}, {{total_3y}} crashes occurred at this unsignalized 4-leg intersection. No fatal or suspected serious injury crashes (K or A) were recorded ({{ka_3y}}). Injury crashes (B or C severity) totaled {{kabc_3y}}. Rear-end ({{rear_end_3y}}) and angle ({{angle_3y}}) crashes were most frequent, with some run-off-road ({{run_off_road_3y}}) and left-turn-opposing ({{left_turn_opposing_3y}}) crashes. Night and wet conditions contributed to {{night_3y}} and {{wet_3y}} crashes. Pedestrian and bicycle counts are not available.
sections.why_flagged: Flagged due to a model-estimated fatal or serious injury crash rate of {{fsi_rate}} per mile per year and an annual fatal or serious injury estimate of {{annual_fsi}}. High traffic exposure ({{aadt}} vehicles/day), 4-leg intersection geometry, proximity to other crash-prone sites, and inclusion in the High Injury Network further raise risk.

countermeasures.rationale: Broader evidence supports this systemic signing and marking improvement package for all crash types and severities, citing {{cmf:8867}}. The CMF is not a direct match for the most frequent crash types here and requires engineering review to confirm applicability, especially given intersection traffic volumes and existing equipment.

Broader evidence supports flashing beacons at stop-controlled intersections for all crash types and severities, citing {{cmf:446}}. The CMF is not a direct match for the crash subtypes observed and requires engineering review to confirm suitability, considering intersection geometry and traffic volumes.

sections.benefit_cost: A numerical benefit could not be computed for either countermeasure. The CMFs are not limited to fatal or serious injury crashes, and there is no audit-approved unit cost or service life available in the library for these treatments.
sections.next_steps: Conduct engineering review to assess intersection geometry, traffic volumes, and existing signing/marking equipment. Confirm prerequisites for both countermeasures, including compatibility with high AADT and four-leg configuration. Evaluate potential for systemic improvements or flashing beacon installation based on site-specific conditions.
